REG-001Implemented

RE legal identity, licence, category, office, and public website

Core · Compliance OS · Owner: Regulatory Compliance

Acceptance boundary

RE legal identity, licence, category, office, and public website is accepted when tenant-scoped execution fails closed on invalid authority or evidence, retains auditable lineage, and the cited automated control-family tests pass.

Current maturity and gap

Executable first-party controls and automated evidence exist for REG-001; production operation still depends on institution configuration and monitored deployment.
